A0_A1.title: Anna
A0_A1.visualDescription: Young woman with short black hair and brown eyes. She wears a bright red sweater and white sneakers.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Anna. I am 22 years old. I am tall. I have short black hair and brown eyes. I like bright red clothes! I wear a red sweater, blue jeans, and white shoes. I have a big happy smile every day!

A0_A1.opener: Hello! I am Anna. Do you like red sweaters or blue jeans?
A0_A1.prompt: Describe Anna. What color is her hair? What clothes does she wear?

A0_A1.title: Marco
A0_A1.visualDescription: Tall young man with curly brown hair, green eyes, and black glasses. He wears a green t-shirt and blue denim jacket.

pages.bio: Hello! My name is Marco. I am 25 years old. I am tall. I have curly brown hair and green eyes. I wear black glasses and a short beard. My clothes are simple: a green t-shirt and a blue jacket.

A0_A1.opener: Hi! Do you wear glasses or have curly hair?
A0_A1.prompt: What color are Marco's eyes and hair? Does he wear glasses?

A2.title: Elena (Athletic & Wavy Auburn Hair)
A2.visualDescription: Athletic woman with medium shoulder-length wavy auburn hair, hazel eyes, light freckles, wearing a navy blue striped shirt.

pages.bio: I am Elena, 24 years old. I am medium height and athletic because I exercise every day. I have wavy auburn hair and hazel eyes with cute freckles. I love casual nautical clothes like navy striped shirts and leather sandals because they are comfortable for beach walks in summer.

A2.opener: Hi! What is your favorite season for casual fashion?
A2.prompt: Describe Elena's build, hair color, and clothing style using A2 connector words.

A2.title: Liam (Tall & Tailored Suit Style)
A2.visualDescription: Tall 6'2" man with neat dark blonde side-part hair and sharp jawline, wearing a tailored navy blazer and clean white shirt.

pages.bio: I am Liam, 27 years old. I am tall (6'2") with a slim frame and broad shoulders. I have short dark blonde hair and a clean-shaven face. I prefer smart-casual elegance because I work in an office. I usually wear navy blazers, white shirts, a leather watch, and brown shoes.

A2.opener: Hello! Do you prefer dressing up formally or wearing cozy casual hoodies?
A2.prompt: How tall is Liam? What does he wear for work and why?

B1.title: Maya (Boho-Chic & Shoulder-Length Curls)
B1.visualDescription: Artistic woman with voluminous dark brown curly hair and expressive dark eyes, wearing an embroidered bohemian kimono and silver rings.

pages.bio: I'm Maya, a 26-year-old artist who is recognized by her expressive dark eyes, sun-kissed complexion, and voluminous shoulder-length dark brown curls. I express my artistic identity through bohemian fashion, which includes flowing embroidered cardigans, vintage silver jewelry, and suede boots.
greenFlags: ✓ Expressive facial features that reflect emotion
✓ Unique personal style that stands out

B1.opener: Hey! How would you describe the relationship between your fashion choices and your personal identity?
B1.prompt: Describe Maya's appearance using relative clauses (who, which) and descriptive vocabulary.

B1.title: Julian (Broad-Shouldered & Rugged Style)
B1.visualDescription: Broad-shouldered man with a trimmed dark beard and short undercut hair, wearing a heavy flannel plaid shirt and durable leather boots.

pages.bio: I'm Julian, a 29-year-old outdoor enthusiast who stands 6'1" tall with a broad-shouldered frame, a neatly trimmed beard, and hazel eyes. My wardrobe centers around functional outdoor aesthetic, featuring heavy flannel plaid shirts, dark selvedge denim, and sturdy leather hiking boots.

B1.opener: Greetings! Do you favor a clean-cut corporate style or an outdoor rugged aesthetic?
B1.prompt: Analyze Julian's physical appearance and explain how his wardrobe reflects his lifestyle.

B2.title: Victoria (Statuesque Elegance & Platinum Bob)
B2.visualDescription: Statuesque 5'10" woman with a razor-sharp platinum blonde bob, piercing ice-blue eyes, high cheekbones, wearing an asymmetrical black blazer.

pages.bio: I'm Victoria, 29. My statuesque 5'10" silhouette is defined by prominent high cheekbones, piercing ice-blue eyes, and a precision-cut platinum blonde bob. My sartorial philosophy embodies high-fashion minimalist tailoring, incorporating structured monochromatic blazers, sleek leather boots, and subtle gold accents.

B2.opener: Welcome! How significantly does sartorial elegance and visual poise influence your interpersonal perception?
B2.prompt: Examine the stylistic impact of Victoria's minimalist wardrobe, hair structure, and commanding demeanor.

B2.title: Gabriel (Charismatic & Silver-Templed Style)
B2.visualDescription: Charismatic 34-year-old man with distinguished silver-templed dark hair and captivating dimples, wearing a tailored charcoal wool coat and silk scarf.

pages.bio: I'm Gabriel, 34. Standing at an athletic 6'0", my appearance balances distinguished silver-templed dark hair, warm hazel eyes, and expressive dimples when laughing. I favor classic European sophistication: tailored charcoal wool overcoats, cashmere turtlenecks, antique leather loafers, and a vintage timepiece.
greenFlags: ✓ Warm disarming smile with natural dimples

B2.opener: Greetings! Do you believe personal style should evolve dynamically or anchor to timeless classicism?
B2.prompt: Analyze how Gabriel's physical attributes convey maturity, charisma, and European sophistication.
